# BPMN Desk 0.3.0

- Camunda 7 support: external tasks, listeners, input/output, forms, connectors, in/out, DMN/call bindings and multi-instance.
- Explicit engine profiles for new diagrams, namespace detection and seven licensed examples.
- PNG export with white/transparent backgrounds, system theme and improved XML search.
- Fixes for dirty state, DI undo, copy/paste, extension XML indentation and notifications.

AppImage, Windows installer/portable and `SHA256SUMS` were built and checked in [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/michaelbrylevskii/bpmn-desk/actions/runs/37992511168).

Camunda 8/Zeebe, DMN/CMMN editing and process execution are not included. Windows executables are unsigned; macOS is not available.
